Title: Guidelines for port State control under MARPOL Annex VI

IMO MEPC.1/Circular MEPC.1/Circ.871/Rev.2 - This circular provides guidance and best practices for Member States, port States, flag States and industry stakeholders under MARPOL Annex VI.

This document is part of Index-of-MEPC-Resolutions-and-Guidelines-related-to-MARPOL-Annex-VI as shown in IMO website screenshot.

Key points for RAG:
- Applicable to fuel oil quality, non-availability, port State control
- References MARPOL Annex VI Regulation 14, 18
- Provides procedures for compliance and enforcement

For full official text, refer to IMODOCS.
